entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
The Royal New Zealand Navy's Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs) can operate 24/7, powered and propelled by sun, wind and wave action.

That makes them ideal long-range platforms to conduct maritime surveillance on a wide variety of tasks.

Their most recent operation was in partnership with New Zealand Customs in Northland monitoring vessels exhibiting behaviours that could indicate narcotics trafficking.
